nodes.label: Decision: RBAC via Role Documents (ObjectId) with Legacy String Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Roles as MongoDB documents allow per-store customization of module/action permissions without redeploy; hardcoded enums and ABAC rejected. userModel.role uses Mixed type accepting ObjectId (new) and String (legacy 'Admin'/'Gerente') as a transitional measure; legacy path is a bypass risk and must be removed after full migration. checkPermission(module, action) supports both formats.

edges.source_location: supersedes the simple string roles documented in Phase 1
